title: Advanced Professional Certificate in Healthcare Economics
description: Through this course, students will gain insights into the unique challenges of healthcare economics, including the trade-offs between quality and cost, the impact of government policies and regulations, and the role of insurance and other forms of financing.
longDescription: The course "Healthcare Economics" aims to provide students with an understanding of the economic principles and tools relevant to the healthcare industry. Through this course, students will gain insights into the unique challenges of healthcare economics, including the trade-offs between quality and cost, the impact of government policies and regulations, and the role of insurance and other forms of financing.
courseDetails: Evaluate the costs and benefits of different healthcare interventions using economic evaluation techniques, such as cost-benefit and cost-effectiveness analyses. Analyze the impact of healthcare policies and interventions on healthcare costs and patient outcomes. Learn effectiveness from a Health Care Planner’s Point of View. Understand the Framework for Economic Analysis. Learn Economic evaluation. Understand the principles of healthcare economics. Understanding how Production, resources, scarcity, and opportunity cost work in healthcare economics. Learn about Markets, Demand, and Supply. Understand Incremental analysis and the margin. Analysing Efficiency and Equity. Optimizing Discounting in accordance with health economics. Analyzing the time horizons. Understand the Economic Models of Healthcare. Learn how economic models of healthcare help in healthcare economics. Analysing market failure in healthcare. Optimizing Economics of Financing Health Care. Understanding of health care reform. Learn about hospital reimbursement. This course provides an introduction to the principles and tools of health economics. Participants will learn about the unique challenges of healthcare economics, including the trade-offs between quality and cost, the impact of government policies and regulations, and the role of insurance and other forms of financing. After the successful completion of this course, you will understand the following; Fundamental Concepts in Healthcare Economics: Economic Evaluation of Healthcare Cost: Understanding the Principles of Healthcare Economics: Understanding Healthcare Economics Models:
